plan: This is a second-price auction (I pay the second-highest bid if I win). In such auctions, the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my true value, regardless of what others do. Bidding higher risks paying more than the item is worth to me; bidding lower risks losing profitable auctions. With my value at $25, I should bid $25 to maximize expected profit.

This is a second-price auction format where I pay the second-highest bid if I win. In such auctions, the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my true value, regardless of what others do. Bidding higher risks overpaying (winning at a price above my value), while bidding lower risks losing profitable opportunities. Since this is a one-shot game with no repeated learning needed, truthful bidding maximizes my expected profit.

This is a second-price auction where the winner pays the second-highest bid. In such auctions, the dominant strategy is to bid your true value, since your bid only determines whether you win, not what you pay. Bidding above value risks paying more than the item is worth; bidding below value risks losing profitable opportunities. My value is $9, so I will bid exactly $9 to maximize expected profit.
